LIVE_VERIFICATION_HALTED 2026-05-24T04:55Z: Pass 1 surfaced P0 ARCHITECTURAL DEFECT (bug 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b). Two coupled symptoms:

DEFECT A: differ emits 'create' mutations for unmapped Jira issues; applier.create_one creates a NEW DUPLICATE Jira issue rather than mirroring down to a local jira-prefixed ticket. 5 confirmed duplicates already in DIG (DIG-4006 through DIG-4010, each a copy of DIG-2099 through DIG-2103 from earlier failed passes). Pass 1 (post-PR-335) would have created ~1820 more duplicates if not for the dedup-by-label short-circuit catching the prior 5.

DEFECT B: bridge_state writes go to main-branch working dir on GHA runner; workflow only commits the tickets-tracker dir. bridge_state thrown away every pass. No prev_snapshot persistence. Differ re-emits all create mutations every pass.

This is NOT a tactical bug-fix — the differ + applier need redesign to separate inbound (Jira to local mirror) from outbound (local SYNC to Jira) flows. Reconciler cannot achieve level-triggered convergence in its current form.

ACTIONS TAKEN:
1. Halted live verification immediately after pass 1 evidence.
2. Disabled scheduled reconcile-bridge.yml cron to prevent further duplication.
3. Filed P0 bug 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b with full evidence.

ACTIONS PENDING USER DIRECTION:
1. Delete the 5 confirmed-duplicate Jira issues (DIG-4006 through DIG-4010) to restore Jira state.
2. Return epic 3a03 to brainstorm with this bug + the 5 prior bugs as inputs.

CLOSURE CHECK FINAL STATUS:
  - CC1, CC3b, CC4, CC5, CC7, SC7: VERIFIED (sufficient evidence captured)
  - CC2, CC3a, CC6, SC1, SC2, SC3, SC4, SC5, SC6: BLOCKED by architectural defect

Verifier-grade summary: the migration INFRASTRUCTURE is sound (workflows, heartbeat canary, fsck audit, ACLI integration after hardening); the migration RECONCILIATION DIRECTION is inverted. The fix requires brainstorm-level rework of the differ/applier contract, not a code patch.
